s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent lesion of the nasal vestibule with local invasion
salient_findings: Recurrent lesion of the right nasal vestibule mucosa
Tumor within the nasal vestibule floor and ala
key_facts: Female patient in her 50s
Never-smoker
Initial lesion biopsied 5 years prior
Initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma
p63 positive, pancytokeratin positive, and p16 negative on initial biopsy
Lesion recurred 8 months prior to presentation
Second excision showed p63 positive and p16 negative with positive margins
Enlarged, firm right ala on examination
Tumor visualized within the nasal vestibule floor and ala
Imaging showed thicker right ala compared to the left ala

differentials: Adenoid cystic carcinoma of the skin
Apocrine carcinoma with signet ring cells
per_call: Adenoid cystic carcinoma of the skin
Apocrine carcinoma with signet ring cells

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent lesion with local invasion and positive margins

shortlist.label: Basal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Common skin cancer with potential for local invasion

shortlist.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant counterpart of hidradenoma, given patient's history of hidradenoma

shortlist.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive salivary gland tumor with potential for local invasion and recurrence

shortlist.label: Mucinous carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rare skin cancer with potential for local invasion and recurrence, given patient's history of hidradenoma

raw.rationale: The patient's initial biopsy was reported as a solid and cystic hidradenoma, which is a benign tumor, but the recurrence and aggressive behavior of the lesion, along with the positive margins on the second excision, suggest a malignant transformation to hidradenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The initial biopsy was p16 negative, which is not typical for squamous cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The biopsy results do not match the typical characteristics of basal cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: The biopsy results do not match the typical characteristics of adenoid cystic carcinoma.

rejected.label: Mucinous carcinoma
rejected.why: There is no mention of mucin production in the biopsy results.
